source.name: BDS Movement targeted boycott list
source.note: Activist campaign list rather than a research database: these are the BDS movement's own current priority targets as published on bdsmovement.net (Guide to BDS Boycott & Pressure Corporate Priority Targeting, published 6 Dec 2024 and current as fetched, plus the Get Involved - Divestment page). Tiers covered: consumer boycott priority targets, grassroots organic boycott targets (campaigns BDS supports but did not initiate), pressure targets, top-priority Israeli divestment/exclusion targets, and the non-exhaustive non-Israeli institutional pressure priority list (military, tech, energy, financial, shipping, others). The consumer-tier item 'Israeli produce' is a product category, not a company, and is omitted. BDS also calls for boycotting all Israeli companies generically; only companies it names individually are included.
